headline: Naples Stone Crab Festival at Tin City
dateline: Through Sun Oct 25 · Tin City, 1200 Fifth Ave S
what: A free three-day stone crab and seafood festival at Historic Tin City, right on the Naples Bay waterfront.
why: If you're in or near Naples this weekend, it's an easy shore stop – but expect a busy bay and busy docks.
todo: Arriving by boat? Call a Naples Bay marina ahead for a slip rather than counting on space near Tin City.
